subject: Reminder: Payment Due for Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear Customer, This is a friendly reminder that the payment for your recent purchase is due tomorrow. Please ensure that the outstanding amount is paid by the due date to avoid any late fees or disruptions to your service. For your convenience, you can easily make the payment online through our secure portal. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. If you have already made the payment, please disregard this message.
